items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: I started playing with Jack Lane.

ctx.x: Violin, guitar, bass, cornton, clannin'. And we plugged around a little around, first thing you know, we run into... Oh, we're done... I started playing with Jack Lane. Oh, yeah. I know him.
Oh, Jack. He's still well. He is, huh? He's talked about you. We interviewed him.

items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23

ctx.x: She's only keeping this stuff since we moved back in this place.
That's Brown, Lopez. This is Loyal Canna.
You know I must have had some dope ones. Oh, I'm telling you, I have it.
